name: Belling 110EBLK — 110cm Cookcentre Range Cooker
short_description: In stock in store at 29 Church St, Dundalk.
description: The Belling Cookcentre 110EBLK is a 110cm electric range cooker in black — a real kitchen centrepiece. A 65L main fan oven, 61L conventional second oven and separate 31L grill (157L total) pair with a five-zone ceramic hob featuring a dual zone and a warming zone. Defrost and slow-cook functions and a Maxi-Clock programmer add everyday flexibility. A/A energy rated.
